**Finding: deviation (high severity) — Section 7.7 (p0032)**

Section 7.7 requires *us* to pay Brightline "as liquidated damages and not as a penalty" fifteen percent of annual Fees for **each week** an invoice is unpaid. This is a Customer-payable liquidated damages provision triggered by a minor administrative breach, and it exceeds the remaining contract value within roughly seven weeks — squarely in the rule's walk-away territory, and well short of the fallback (a capped early-termination fee).

I confirmed there is no other Customer-payable liquidated amount: Sections 9.4 and 10.2 limit us to accrued Fees with refunds of prepayments, and Section 10 contains no minimum or early-termination fee. Service credits running to us were not flagged.

Redline (validated, preferred position): replace the liquidated damages charge with simple interest at 1% per month on proper, undisputed overdue invoices, expressly excluding any penalty, and preserving the Section 7.3 good-faith withholding right.
